document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Your party decides that the nearby cave makes a good base for 
further exploration. You work your way through a rough stretch 
shaded by fragrant black spruces and balsam firs. At the foot of 
a stream-dug ravine, you catch the whiff of sulfur. You dip your 
hand in the water and feel a pleasant warmth. It must drain 
almost directly from a hot spring.

Your  group  follows  the  waterway  upstream.  You  notice 
mineral deposits on the stones around the creek. The farther 
you go, the heavier they become.
